findings.title: Generated Project Understanding Markdown fails diff hygiene checks
findings.observedBehavior: The Markdown generator appends two spaces before each newline in every list entry. The generated reports/project-understanding.md therefore causes git diff --check to fail with trailing-whitespace errors.
findings.expectedBehavior: Generated repository artifacts should pass the repository's whitespace check unless a documented formatter exception exists.
findings.impact: A normal pre-commit hygiene check fails after regenerating Project Understanding, obscuring real whitespace defects and adding review noise.

evidence.description: markdownList deliberately emits two trailing spaces before the line break.
Generated list output contains the trailing whitespace detected by git diff --check.

findings.resolution: Emit ordinary Markdown list lines without trailing spaces, or adopt a documented formatter exception and test it explicitly.
verification: Run git diff --check and confirm it exits successfully.
Preserve Markdown readability in the generated report.

findings.title: Project guide validation does not bind the current guide or Understanding Markdown content
findings.observedBehavior: documentation-builder validate compares the stored Understanding Markdown digest to the digest value in the Understanding JSON, but does not hash the current Understanding Markdown file. It also checks only the guide title, so an edited guide body can still validate.
findings.expectedBehavior: A canonical evidence-bound guide validation should reject a guide whose body or source Understanding Markdown has changed after generation.
findings.impact: Downstream Project Video and presentation workflows can accept altered documentation while reporting it as evidence-bound to the current repository scan.

evidence.description: validate checks metadata and claim evidence but does not compare a hash of the current guide or Understanding Markdown content.
validateExisting loads the current guide and Understanding files but relies on the incomplete validation routine.
The regression test covers successful generation and validation but not post-generation tampering of either bound document.

findings.resolution: Record a SHA-256 digest for the rendered guide in the guide report, compare it during validation, and hash the current Project Understanding Markdown against its declared digest. Add tamper regression tests for both files.
verification: Build and validate a guide successfully.
Modify the guide body and confirm validate fails.
Modify project-understanding.md without updating its JSON digest and confirm validate fails.

limitations: The audit did not contact Azure, package registries, hosted CI, or external advisory services.
